correctness.rationale: Reachable inputs equal the fixed tabular logic and hence have all seven properties; non-reachable inputs are both Kripke-incomplete and undecidable, while each of the other six properties implies Kripke completeness. The Boolean-separator consequence follows exactly from the resulting two endpoint vectors.

originality.rationale: Targeted literature and semantic searches found the source reduction and an earlier K4_t analogue, but no published statement of the synchronized seven-bit Grz_t spectrum, its promise form, or its Boolean-separator closure.

value.rationale: The result identifies a single common hard core for seven major semantic and algorithmic properties, strengthens the reading to a promise problem, and makes explicit which Boolean combinations inherit undecidability on that family.
